hdmi_tx.description: An HDMI/DVI transmitter: parallel video in, a TMDS link out. Every implementation offers these ports; how it is configured on a board, and which pins it lands on, is that board's.

pixel_khz.description: The pixel clock it transmits at.

serial_clock.description: 1: its bit clock, five times the pixel clock, is given (sclk) rather than made inside -- one clock manager for the raster and its serializer, at any pixel clock that manager can make.

inputs.name: rgb
inputs.description: The raster's video, 8 bits a channel.

inputs.name: sclk
inputs.description: Five times pclk, in phase with it.

outputs.name: TMDS
outputs.description: The link, to the jack's pins.

rgb2dvi.description: Digilent's rgb2dvi on a 7-series part: TMDS encoded and serialised in the fabric, its serial clock made by its own PLL. Needs Digilent's vivado-library in the IP catalogue.

config.kClkRange: 1 if serial_clock or pixel_khz >= 120000 else 2 if pixel_khz >= 60000 else 3
